description: This file is a script written in JavaScript, using modern ES Module syntax, intended to be executed with Node.js. It orchestrates a series of build, snapshot, and run-time tests for a project, particularly focused on gateway regression testing, including process management, file system snapshotting, and analysis of build triggers and resource usage.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to override default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes to normalize file paths.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists all entries within a directory tree rooted at a given directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the directory tree, capturing stats like file count and total size.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates snapshot files for directories 'dist' and 'dist-runtime'.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously, throwing if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a Promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Builds a command configuration for running a timed watch process.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses the timing output file generated by the /usr/bin/time command.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Executes the watch process with timing and process management, returning its results.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a list of file paths from a text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Compares directory snapshots and writes added and removed paths to files.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout/stderr to determine why a build was triggered.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Builds a configuration object representing the environment and dependencies for run-node.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating the entire regression check process.
